summary: A Yes vote enacts a special parcel tax of $0.0354 per lot square foot with low-income exemptions to fund street tree and streetlighting maintenance, raising about $775,000 per year until ended by voters.

tax.text: The League of Women Voters supported a Yes vote on Measure T, which would create a parcel tax to fund street-tree and streetlighting maintenance and improvements.
tax.quote: Measure T — Street Trees & Streetlighting Tax : SUPPORT
